audit.whatIsWrong: Chart calls level 1, levels 4-5 and level 6 even while every why on the page describes Fiora winning that stage against an escape-less mage.
audit.why: whys[0] says she has no dash and one poke tool, whys[3] says you chain Lunges onto an immobile mage, whys[4] calls the level-6 all-in 'a clean kill on her'. packet.levelChart is Fiora at all seven stages, and the mirror (mel__fiora) already proposed Fiora at all seven as one atomic group — matching it keeps the two pages from contradicting.
audit.corrected: win[0], win[3], win[4] and phases[0], phases[3], phases[4] -> Fiora, ratings raised across the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Rebuttal's is the one number that changes how you play the lane.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26 — at rank 1 a spent barrier leaves her defenceless for well over half a minute. Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, Radiant Volley 10/9/8/7/6, Golden Eclipse 120/100/80; Fiora W is 24s, R 110s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and dosFull[2].d now carry 11s, 38s, 24s and 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page sells Rebuttal's projectile reflection as a reason not to commit. Against Fiora that half of the ability does nothing — she has no projectiles. What actually matters is the flat damage immunity for the duration. Also missing: Searing Brilliance loads bonus projectiles onto her NEXT attack after any cast, so the attack wind-up is the burst tell.
audit.why: Riot's text: the barrier 'reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed'. Fiora's Q, E and R are all melee/point-blank, so only the damage prevention is live here. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion from Mel's side.
audit.corrected: wants.you[2] and dontsFull[1].d now frame Rebuttal as a damage blank to wait out; dontsFull[2].d names the Searing Brilliance wind-up. The Riposte-parries-Solar-Snare-into-a-stun claim is CORRECT — Solar Snare roots.

edits.before: Don't dump your combo into her Rebuttal (W) barrier — it blocks your damage and reflects projectiles, so wait it out, then commit your Q-chain and E burst
edits.after: Don't dump your combo into her Rebuttal (W) barrier — it blanks damage outright and you have no projectile to reflect, so wait it out, then commit

edits.before: - Mel Solar Snare: matchup-defining — Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Mel Solar Snare: matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1, her only lockdown; parry the root and it returns as your stun. - Rebuttal: 38s at rank 1, so bait it and commit after. - Riposte: 24s. - Grand Challenge: 110s.

edits.before: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her root and slow zone — 11s at rank 1, and it sets up her whole combo. Parry it.

edits.after: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Mel, AA once, E-slow out — Rebuttal is 38s, so a spent barrier is your window.

edits.after: Mel spends Solar Snare — 11s with no lockdown. Commit now.

edits.before: That is Mel's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
